summary: 人形、静止反应对手，三初态/点；相关与条件误差只覆盖该夹具。全图先验和双敌模型未获得原生等价认证。
scope: Step1 threat controls separately prove actual52 hits/KO.
Native initial prior: static reachable <=30u nodes, >=10u from source; human only, three sampled poses/point, stand/react18 only.
R1 correction: Beta(1,1) binding-neighborhood and bounded-aim feasibility, fit on trials0/1 only.

R2 correction: effective controller shot reliability, preparation median, defender aim/pitch error; fit on trials0/1, hold trial2 out. These are surrogate priors, not changed native weapon damage or universal player accuracy.
Native hook contact, finite projectile collision volumes, arbitrary elevation and camera/gyro coupling remain structural uncertainties.
Global-prior rank correlation is reported separately because its prior differs from native validation.
N3/point cannot establish highest native kill probability; Beta intervals overlap. No D3 success flag manufactured.
